# palmhillsdev

> palmhillsdev (palmhillsdev.com) is a marketing platform for Palm Hills Developments projects in Egypt, owned and run by Ibrahim El Garhy, Sales Manager at Palm Hills. It is not the official Palm Hills website. It lists available units, prices and payment plans; contracts are signed directly with Palm Hills Developments.

Prices are in Egyptian pounds (EGP), are indicative, and may be changed by the developer without notice.
Contact: phone / WhatsApp +201031170002, email ibrahimelgarhy1987@gmail.com. The site is available in Arabic (https://palmhillsdev.com/) and English (https://palmhillsdev.com/en/).

## Projects (Palm Hills Developments)

- [Hacienda Ras El Hekma](https://palmhillsdev.com/en/hacienda-ras-el-hekma): Ras El Hekma — North Coast. From EGP 12,243,000, 5% down payment, up to 10 years installments, delivery 2030.
- [Badya Palm Hills](https://palmhillsdev.com/en/badya): 6th of October — West Cairo. From EGP 7,090,120, 1.5% down payment, up to 12 years installments, delivery 2029 – 2031.
- [PX Palm Hills](https://palmhillsdev.com/en/px): 6th of October — West Cairo. From EGP 15,226,000, 5% down payment, up to 10 years installments, delivery 2027 – 2030.
- [97 Hills](https://palmhillsdev.com/en/97-hills): New Cairo. From EGP 29,189,000, 2.8% down payment, up to 10 years installments, delivery 2031.
- [Village de la Capitale](https://palmhillsdev.com/en/palm-hills-new-capital) (also known as Palm Hills New Capital): New Administrative Capital — R4. From EGP 7,127,000, 1.5% down payment, up to 12 years installments, delivery 2031.

## Hacienda Ras El Hekma

Page: https://palmhillsdev.com/en/hacienda-ras-el-hekma (Arabic: https://palmhillsdev.com/hacienda-ras-el-hekma)

Hacienda Ras El Hekma is Palm Hills Developments' newest North Coast destination, covering around 1,400 feddans in Ras El Hekma with a 4.8 km sandy beachfront. The master plan is by OBMI and is laid out around lagoons and green spaces, with beach homes, chalets, twin houses and villas set in rows stepping back from the sea. All units are delivered fully finished with air conditioning and kitchens, with delivery expected in 2030.

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| First Row Villa | — | 500,000,000 |
| Beachfront Villa | Built-up area 344 m², land area 942 m² | 202,498,000 |
| Bayline Villa | Built-up area 344 m², land area 841 m² | 170,389,000 |
| Coastal Villa | Built-up area 519 m², land area 800 m² | 130,058,000 |
| Crest Villa | Built-up area 312 m², land area 419 m² | 82,188,000 |
| Duo Twin | Built-up area 253 m², land area 320 m² | 48,773,000 |
| Seabreeze Grand Chalet | 202 – 215 m² | 33,658,000 |
| Seabreeze Senior Chalet | 167 m² | 27,648,000 |
| Seabreeze Junior Chalet | 141 m² | 23,995,000 |
| Beach Home 3 Bedrooms | 143 m² | 18,448,000 |
| Beach Home 2 Bedrooms | 105 – 107 m² | 15,545,000 |
| Beach Home 1 Bedroom | 65 m² | 12,243,000 |

**Where is Hacienda Ras El Hekma located?** Hacienda Ras El Hekma is in Ras El Hekma on the International Coastal Road of Egypt's North Coast, one of the calmest and clearest bays on the Mediterranean. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in Hacienda Ras El Hekma?** Prices start from EGP 12,243,000. Available units: First Row Villa from EGP 500,000,000; Beachfront Villa from EGP 202,498,000; Bayline Villa from EGP 170,389,000; Coastal Villa from EGP 130,058,000; Crest Villa from EGP 82,188,000; Duo Twin from EGP 48,773,000; Seabreeze Grand Chalet from EGP 33,658,000; Seabreeze Senior Chalet from EGP 27,648,000; Seabreeze Junior Chalet from EGP 23,995,000; Beach Home 3 Bedrooms from EGP 18,448,000; Beach Home 2 Bedrooms from EGP 15,545,000; Beach Home 1 Bedroom from EGP 12,243,000.

**What payment plans are available in Hacienda Ras El Hekma?** Payment plan: 5% down payment, 5% after 3 months; installments over 10 years at the original price, or 8 years with 10% off, or 6 years with 20% off.

**What unit types and sizes are available in Hacienda Ras El Hekma?** Beachfront Villa (Built-up area 344 m², land area 942 m²); Bayline Villa (Built-up area 344 m², land area 841 m²); Coastal Villa (Built-up area 519 m², land area 800 m²); Crest Villa (Built-up area 312 m², land area 419 m²); Duo Twin (Built-up area 253 m², land area 320 m²); Seabreeze Grand Chalet (202 – 215 m²); Seabreeze Senior Chalet (167 m²); Seabreeze Junior Chalet (141 m²); Beach Home 3 Bedrooms (143 m²); Beach Home 2 Bedrooms (105 – 107 m²); Beach Home 1 Bedroom (65 m²).

**When is Hacienda Ras El Hekma delivered?** Delivery is expected in 2030, according to the developer.

**Are Hacienda Ras El Hekma homes finished?** Yes, all the units shown are delivered fully finished.

**Is palmhillsdev.com the official Hacienda Ras El Hekma website?** No. The developer is Palm Hills Developments. palmhillsdev.com is a marketing platform owned by Ibrahim El Garhy, Sales Manager at Palm Hills. Contracts are signed directly with the company.

**Are the prices shown final?** Prices are indicative and may be changed by the developer without notice. The developer is the final reference at the time of contracting.

## Badya Palm Hills

Page: https://palmhillsdev.com/en/badya (Arabic: https://palmhillsdev.com/badya)

Badya is an integrated city by Palm Hills Developments in 6th of October on Al Wahat Road, divided into 6 districts, each with its own plan and services, connected through a central hub called The Core. The city is built around a smart, green concept, with Badya International University, schools, sports clubs and walking and cycling trails. Units available now are in Districts 2 and 6: fully finished one- to three-bedroom apartments, plus core & shell town houses and villas.

| Town House Corner | Built-up area 194 m², land area 230 m² | 23,968,000 |

| Villa Z2 | Built-up area 275.5 m², land area 401 m² | 34,745,000 |
| Villa X2 | Built-up area 364 m², land area 550 m² | 43,189,000 |
| Villa W2 | Built-up area 466 m², land area 750 m² | 57,780,000 |

**Where is Badya Palm Hills located?** Badya is in 6th of October, Giza, on Al Wahat Road, close to the 26th of July Corridor and Zewail Road, and to West Cairo's main landmarks. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in Badya Palm Hills?** Prices start from EGP 7,090,120. Available units: 1 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 7,090,120; 2 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 9,759,360; 3 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 11,825,000; Town House Middle from EGP 22,005,000; Town House Corner from EGP 23,968,000; Villa N2 from EGP 25,762,000; Villa Z2 from EGP 34,745,000; Villa X2 from EGP 43,189,000; Villa W2 from EGP 57,780,000.

Option 2: 1.5% down payment, 1.5% after 1 month, 1.5% after 2 months, 1.5% after 3 months; installments over 12 years with 4% off, or 10 years with 14% off, or 8 years with 25% off, or 6 years with 43% off.

**What unit types and sizes are available in Badya Palm Hills?** 1 Bedroom Apartment (58 – 70 m²); 2 Bedroom Apartment (93 – 135 m²); 3 Bedroom Apartment (125 – 168 m²); Town House Middle (Built-up area 190.5 m², land area 189.5 m²); Town House Corner (Built-up area 194 m², land area 230 m²); Villa N2 (Built-up area 180 m², land area 255 m²); Villa Z2 (Built-up area 275.5 m², land area 401 m²); Villa X2 (Built-up area 364 m², land area 550 m²); Villa W2 (Built-up area 466 m², land area 750 m²).

## PX Palm Hills

Page: https://palmhillsdev.com/en/px (Arabic: https://palmhillsdev.com/px)

PX (P/X) is a residential project by Palm Hills Developments on the highest point of the Palm Hills October area in West Cairo, so homes sit on raised levels with open views of the Pyramids and the neighbouring golf courses. Although it sits higher than the other projects, PX is central to Palm Hills' October communities, close to Palm Central, the clubs and the malls. Inside the project are The St. Regis Palm Hills hotel, with serviced apartments and branded residences, and a new extension of Palm Hills Sports Club. Available now: fully finished one- to three-bedroom-plus-nanny apartments, town houses and villas, with apartment delivery starting in 2027.

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Bedroom Apartment | 77.84 m² | 15,226,000 |
| 2 Bedroom Apartment | 119.16 – 139.65 m² | 20,510,000 |
| 3 Bedroom Apartment | 144.18 – 171.80 m² | 26,319,000 |
| 3 Bedroom + Nanny Apartment | 170.17 – 171.17 m² | 26,547,000 |
| Town House Middle | Built-up area 200.72 m², land area 212 m² | 29,538,000 |
| Town House Corner | Built-up area 213.61 m², land area 215.5 m² | 34,922,000 |
| Villa 1 | Built-up area 313.67 m², land area 420.06 – 470.28 m² | 54,670,000 |
| Villa 5 | Built-up area 428.04 m², land area 545.16 m² | 68,880,000 |

**Where is PX Palm Hills located?** PX sits on the highest point of the Palm Hills October area in the heart of West Cairo, central to the other Palm Hills communities and close to the Giza Pyramids, the Grand Egyptian Museum and the main roads. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in PX Palm Hills?** Prices start from EGP 15,226,000. Available units: 1 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 15,226,000; 2 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 20,510,000; 3 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 26,319,000; 3 Bedroom + Nanny Apartment from EGP 26,547,000; Town House Middle from EGP 29,538,000; Town House Corner from EGP 34,922,000; Villa 1 from EGP 54,670,000; Villa 5 from EGP 68,880,000.

**What payment plans are available in PX Palm Hills?** Apartments: 5% down payment; installments over 10 years at the original price, or 9 years with 12% off, or 8 years with 20% off, or 7 years with 27% off, or 6 years with 35% off, or 5 years with 40% off. Town houses & villas: 5% down payment, 5% after 3 months; installments over 7.5 years at the original price.

**What unit types and sizes are available in PX Palm Hills?** 1 Bedroom Apartment (77.84 m²); 2 Bedroom Apartment (119.16 – 139.65 m²); 3 Bedroom Apartment (144.18 – 171.80 m²); 3 Bedroom + Nanny Apartment (170.17 – 171.17 m²); Town House Middle (Built-up area 200.72 m², land area 212 m²); Town House Corner (Built-up area 213.61 m², land area 215.5 m²); Villa 1 (Built-up area 313.67 m², land area 420.06 – 470.28 m²); Villa 5 (Built-up area 428.04 m², land area 545.16 m²).

**When is PX Palm Hills delivered?** Delivery is expected in 2027 – 2030, according to the developer.

**Is palmhillsdev.com the official PX Palm Hills website?** No. The developer is Palm Hills Developments. palmhillsdev.com is a marketing platform owned by Ibrahim El Garhy, Sales Manager at Palm Hills. Contracts are signed directly with the company.

**Are the prices shown final?** Prices are indicative and may be changed by the developer without notice. The developer is the final reference at the time of contracting.

## 97 Hills

Page: https://palmhillsdev.com/en/97-hills (Arabic: https://palmhillsdev.com/97-hills)

97 Hills is a residential project by Palm Hills Developments in New Cairo, with family homes with a garden or penthouse, town houses, and standalone villas in several sizes. Family homes and town houses are delivered fully finished and villas core & shell, with delivery expected in 2031. The project includes a clubhouse, a pool, green spaces, walking and cycling trails and a commercial promenade.

## Village de la Capitale

Page: https://palmhillsdev.com/en/palm-hills-new-capital (Arabic: https://palmhillsdev.com/palm-hills-new-capital)

Village de la Capitale is Palm Hills Developments' first residential community in the New Administrative Capital, spread over 314 feddans in the R4 district. It is the closest residential community to New Cairo, only seven minutes from Palm Hills New Cairo. The master plan was designed with SWA, an international landscape firm, and follows the land's natural levels, so green spaces, pathways and water features run between the homes. The community includes one- to three-bedroom apartments (some with gardens), town houses and villas, with an international school, a commercial hub and a clubhouse. Delivery is expected in 2031.

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Bedroom Apartment | 61.5 – 62.5 m² | 7,127,000 |
| 2 Bedroom Apartment | 94 – 102 m² | 10,867,000 |
| 3 Bedroom Apartment | 146 – 150 m² | 14,809,000 |
| Town House Middle | Built-up area 176.5 m², land area 186 m² | 24,783,000 |
| Town House Corner | Built-up area 176.5 m², land area 186 m² | 27,284,000 |
| Villa C | Built-up area 185 m², land area 282 m² | 31,844,000 |
| Villa A | Built-up area 262 m², land area 371.5 m² | 44,970,000 |

**Is Palm Hills New Capital the same as Village de la Capitale?** Yes. Village de la Capitale is the Palm Hills project in the New Administrative Capital and the company's first residential community there, in the R4 district.

**Where is Village de la Capitale located?** Village de la Capitale is in the R4 district of the New Administrative Capital. It is the Capital's closest residential community to New Cairo, seven minutes from Palm Hills New Cairo, with easy access to Bin Zayed Axis. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in Village de la Capitale?** Prices start from EGP 7,127,000. Available units: 1 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 7,127,000; 2 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 10,867,000; 3 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 14,809,000; Town House Middle from EGP 24,783,000; Town House Corner from EGP 27,284,000; Villa C from EGP 31,844,000; Villa A from EGP 44,970,000.

**What payment plans are available in Village de la Capitale?** Payment plan: 1.5% down payment; installments over 12 years at the original price, or 10 years with 15% off.

**What unit types and sizes are available in Village de la Capitale?** 1 Bedroom Apartment (61.5 – 62.5 m²); 2 Bedroom Apartment (94 – 102 m²); 3 Bedroom Apartment (146 – 150 m²); Town House Middle (Built-up area 176.5 m², land area 186 m²); Town House Corner (Built-up area 176.5 m², land area 186 m²); Villa C (Built-up area 185 m², land area 282 m²); Villa A (Built-up area 262 m², land area 371.5 m²).

**When is Village de la Capitale delivered?** Delivery is expected in 2031, according to the developer.
